tagline: The gateway to Isan — Khao Yai, Khmer temples, and vineyards an easy drive from Bangkok
introHtml: Nakhon Ratchasima, which everyone just calls Korat, is the first big city you hit coming into Isan, and it's not a long drive from Bangkok. The Thao Suranari (Ya Mo) monument sits right at the heart of town. Up in the hills you've got Khao Yai for cool air and forest walks where you might spot wildlife, plus the ancient Khmer-era stone sanctuary at Phimai. Around Pak Chong there are vineyards and sheep farms you can poke around in all day. If you want to start an Isan trip without going too far, Korat fits the bill nicely.
bestTime: November–February, cool and comfortable — ideal for Khao Yai and being outdoors

highlights.name: Thao Suranari Monument (Ya Mo)
highlights.blurb: The center and symbol of Korat — locals come to pay respects daily, with food stalls and the Chumphon Gate all around

highlights.name: Khao Yai
highlights.blurb: The famous national park on the Pak Chong side, with waterfalls, viewpoints, hiking trails, and a real chance of seeing wild elephants and other animals

highlights.name: Phimai Historical Park
highlights.blurb: One of the oldest and largest Khmer sanctuaries in Thailand, with finely carved sandstone you can wander for hours

highlights.name: Pak Chong — vineyards and farms
highlights.blurb: A hilly zone packed with vineyards, wineries, sheep farms, and mountain-view cafes — a popular stop before heading up to Khao Yai

highlights.name: Pak Thong Chai silk
highlights.blurb: Korat's renowned silk-weaving area — handsome patterns and dense weave, a classic souvenir and local craft

highlights.name: Ya Mo Plaza — Chumphon Gate
highlights.blurb: The old-town core with city walls and an ancient gate; come evening, people stroll here and food markets open up

foodScene.name: Pad Mee Korat
foodScene.note: Stir-fried rice noodles done the local way, sweet-leaning with a sour kick — a signature dish you have to try

foodScene.name: Isan food
foodScene.note: Som tam, larb, nam tok, grilled chicken — found on every corner, bold and properly Isan

foodScene.name: Mee Takhu
foodScene.note: Chewy dried rice noodles from Pak Thong Chai district; blanched and sauced or stir-fried, both great, and a popular thing to take home

foodScene.name: Pak Chong coffee and cafes
foodScene.note: The Pak Chong–Khao Yai zone is full of cafes with mountain and vineyard views — easy spots to sip coffee in the cool air

foodScene.name: Khao Yai wine and grapes
foodScene.note: Wineries around Pak Chong open for tastings and seasonal grape picking, with vineyard-view restaurants to linger at

foodScene.name: Korat moo yor and sausage
foodScene.note: Dense, mellow-flavored souvenirs — take some home or eat with rice porridge, either works

foodScene.name: Save One Market — night market
foodScene.note: The city's well-known night market, full of street food, grilled snacks, and bites to graze on after dark

attractions.name: Khao Yai National Park
attractions.blurb: A big forest close to the capital, with Haew Suwat Waterfall, viewpoints, and night safari trails for spotting wildlife

attractions.name: Phimai Historical Park
attractions.blurb: A large Khmer sandstone sanctuary in the middle of Phimai district, with beautiful carvings and a long history

attractions.name: Thao Suranari Monument
attractions.blurb: The downtown landmark Korat locals revere, with a plaza ringed by walking spots and food

attractions.name: Petrified Wood Museum
attractions.blurb: A site of petrified wood and ancient elephant fossils — see fossils that go back millions of years

attractions.name: GranMonte Vineyard
attractions.blurb: A mountain-view winery near Pak Chong — walk the vineyard, taste the wine, and eat surrounded by green hills

attractions.name: Farm Chokchai
attractions.blurb: A large dairy farm on the Mittraphap Road, with milking, horse riding, and a cowboy show the kids love

attractions.name: Wat Ban Rai (Luang Phor Khun)
attractions.blurb: A famous temple in Dan Khun Thot district, with the spectacular ceramic-clad Thep Witthayakhom shrine to see

attractions.name: Lam Takhong Dam
attractions.blurb: A wide reservoir off the Mittraphap Road, with a wind-turbine viewpoint and a breezy, easygoing atmosphere
